name: K-●N! Houkago Inbi Chouritsu
original_name: けい●ん!放課後淫美調律
source:
Based on the mega-popular anime/manga "K-ON!".

Ahhh, we love 'After School Tea Time'.
The girl band with that bass player's sexy ass in striped panties...
It seemed the chance to get ahold of them outside of school was impossible. But when they appear at a live house, hearts go aflutter at the possibility of meeting them...
